title: docs(hooks): state what a hook body's ctx.api.transaction joins and where it stops; skills: the measured MongoDB and PostgreSQL rule
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-sales"} -->
_Requested by **Sales** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4Uu?thread=cmsg_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4UuHK25Zwk1bxA8Zwyv3FSnHC)_

Fixes #35324
Fixes #37992

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 是什么：写钩子和动作脚本的开发者（以及照技能写代码的 AI）在文档和数据技能里能读到「脚本里的事务能做到哪、到哪为止」：同一段脚本里事务不能再套事务；脚本自己开的事务里触发的钩子会并进同一个事务；写到别的数据源会被拒（审计、遥测这类只追加的日志表除外）；PostgreSQL 和 MongoDB 副本集上一条语句失败整个事务作废；不支持事务的数据库上什么也不回滚且没有提示。MongoDB 那句「未实测」换成了实测结论。运行时行为不变。
- 为什么：属于「AI 照技能写出能跑的元数据」。这些边界以前只能在报错时撞上，其中 MongoDB 单机与 PostgreSQL 的规则上一张卡已实测。
- 出错会怎样：只是文档、技能文字和两条测试，写错了是教错，可直接撤回；技能文件已在字数上限，新增靠删掉同文件里重复的代码注释来付。
- 要你做的：技能目录属于需你批准合并的路径，请审后批准合并。

## What changes

**Premise corrected** (card comment 7234049171): on `main` 0e361201 a test already pinned the nested refusal (asserting only the throw), and a body's own unit IS joined: `publishTrioHandleFor` (`packages/objectql/src/engine-middleware-and-context.ts`) publishes the trio's handle per operation. Measured on the real engine, real QuickJS and a rollback-honest driver: a hook fired by a write inside a trio-opened transaction, `beforeInsert` or `afterInsert`, with or without its own `ctx.api.transaction`, ran on the one handle with one `begin`, and commit kept both rows while rollback kept neither (8 of 8). So the docs and the skill teach the join, not a second unit.

- `packages/runtime/src/sandbox/quickjs-runner.test.ts`: "rejects a nested transaction" now asserts a `SandboxError`, exactly one `begin`, the outer unit rolled back, no commit, and nothing after the nested call run.
- `packages/runtime/src/sandbox/transaction-ambient-join.integration.test.ts`: two cases on the hook-body face (the engine face is `engine-ambient-transaction.test.ts`): inside a transaction opened through `ScopedContext`'s trio, as an action body's `ctx.api.transaction` opens it, the hook body's `ctx.api.transaction` joins it (one begin, both writes on its handle, one commit), and its rollback undoes the hook's write.
- `content/docs/automation/hooks.mdx`: new subsection "What `ctx.api.transaction` joins, and where it stops": joins any open unit, including one a body opened, and hooks of writes inside it join it; one level per body (nested refused); default datasource only, ledger carve-out; a failed statement aborts the unit on PostgreSQL and a MongoDB replica set even when caught; no unit and no warning on a driver with no transactions. The async after-hook bullet's "A nested `transaction()` joins" is bounded and links there.
- `skills/objectstack-data/references/data-hooks.md`: the `before*` Transaction cell replaces "MongoDB needs a replica set (read in code, not measured)" with the measured rule (standalone refuses every write of such a transaction, `501 NOT_IMPLEMENTED`, a single-node replica set is enough; on PostgreSQL and a MongoDB replica set a failed `ctx.api` statement refuses the outer write even when caught, logged or retried, `25P02` / `251`; SQLite lets it through). The `api.transaction` row carries the same bounds as the page. The Best Practices ledger sentence points at that row instead of repeating it.
- `skills/objectstack-data/evals/hooks-security-seeds-datasources.json`: the "not measured" case now expects the measured rule; the cross-datasource case names the ledger carve-out.
- `.changeset/35324-hook-transaction-bounds.md`: `@objectstack/skills` patch (the package ships `skills/**`). The runtime change is tests only and ships nothing.

**Skills readings** (lines / bytes, base 0e361201 → head):

| | before | after |
|:--|--:|--:|
| `data-hooks.md` | 872 / 40480 | 856 / 40477 |
| `hooks-security-seeds-datasources.json` (eval, unpriced) | 391 / 39028 | 391 / 39521 |
| all `skills/**/SKILL.md`, lines | 4952 | 4952 |
| whole `skills/` tree, bytes | 1224261 | 1224751 |

`data-hooks.md` stays at 10120 tokens, its ceiling (headroom 0). The +878 bytes added are paid by 881 bytes cut in the same file: restating code comments (`// Required: Target object(s)` → `// Required` and five like it; "Database transaction handle", "Cross-object CRUD API", "Record ID being updated / deleted", "Only fields being changed", "Mask sensitive fields", two `candidate` example comments), section labels ("Insert / Update / Delete / Query operations:", "Mutable data", "Execution context", "Engine access", "Available in `after*` hooks:"), and five clauses each stated elsewhere in the file ("`await` is allowed", "In an `after*` hook the body is for side effects", "isolated QuickJS VM", ", not a global admin bypass", "(surfaces as a hook error)", the inline-`handler`-deprecated note, and the ledger definition now in the `api.transaction` row). No fact leaves the file.

The `skills/**` edits were written by an isolated sub-agent at the contract-review tier; `node scripts/pm/verify-review-tier.mjs` on its transcript: `PASS — 22 assistant turn(s), every one served at CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`.

The rest, `pnpm typecheck` for `@objectstack/runtime` and the full `Test Core` run: NOT MEASURED locally (dependencies built with `OS_SKIP_DTS=1`), left to CI.

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- `data-hooks.md` has a code comment "in your plugin's onEnable()" (Plugin Integration section) while the kernel contract has no `onEnable`; untouched here, noted for the skills lane.
- The PostgreSQL rule inside an action body's own (owned) transaction is stated from the measured rule for a unit ("a statement that fails at the database aborts the whole unit"); the measurement itself was taken on a `before*` hook's unit.

## Verification

Read first: the `api.transaction` row of `data-hooks.md`; the new subsection of `hooks.mdx`; the two new cases at the end of `transaction-ambient-join.integration.test.ts`.

Two-minute check: `pnpm --filter @objectstack/runtime exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 src/sandbox/transaction-ambient-join.integration.test.ts` shows 8 passed.
